summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a 6-K attaching a September 16, 2026 news release disclosing receipt of over USD $7 million in proceeds from exercises of common share purchase warrants originally issued in October 17 and 20, 2025 private placements. The company declared its Acceleration Right effective as of the September 15, 2026 market close; 425,000 of the original 5,712,500 warrants remained unexercised, representing up to USD $573,750 in additional gross proceeds. Unexercised warrants expire at 4:00 p.m. Eastern on October 16, 2026, the 30th day following the Acceleration Notice, after which they are automatically cancelled for no consideration. Proceeds extend cash runway into H1 2028, funding operations through the pivotal Phase III MAVERIC topline readout. This is a warrant-acceleration capital-raising notice rather than a conventional special situation; it is closest to an issuer-driven capital structure event, though no equity repurchase, tender, or dividend is involved, and investors should watch the residual 425,000-warrant expiry cliff and any post-MAVERIC financing needs.
